title: Tilting Tray Relocate
name: tilting_tray_relocate
description: An object rests in an OPEN tray, plainly visible at the near end. A lid closes over it; the tray then tilts so the hidden object slides under the cover to the far end and the tray levels out; finally the lid lifts at that far end to reveal the same object has moved there, unchanged.
